mapper.update: MERGE INTO USER_LOCATIONS ul USING ( SELECT #{userNo} AS USERNO, #{latitude} AS LATITUDE, #{longitude} AS LONGITUDE FROM dual ) dummy ON (ul.USERNO = dummy.USERNO) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET ul.LATITUDE = dummy.LATITUDE, ul.LONGITUDE = dummy.LONGITUDE, ul.LAST_UPDATED = SYSTIMESTAMP, ul.LOCATION = SDO_GEOMETRY(2001, 8307, SDO_POINT_TYPE(dummy.LONGITUDE, dummy.LATITUDE, NULL), NULL, NULL) WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (USERNO, LATITUDE, LONGITUDE, LAST_UPDATED, LOCATION) VALUES (dummy.USERNO, dummy.LATITUDE, dummy.LONGITUDE, SYSTIMESTAMP, SDO_GEOMETRY(2001, 8307, SDO_POINT_TYPE(dummy.LONGITUDE, dummy.LATITUDE, NULL), NULL, NULL))
mapper.select:
SELECT "u"."userNo", "u"."userName", -- 🛠️ [수정 1] 생년월일(String)을 나이(숫자)로 변환하여 'age' 필드에 매핑 -- DTO에 userBirth가 아닌 age(int) 필드가 있기 때문에 변환이 필수입니다. TRUNC(MONTHS_BETWEEN(SYSDATE, TO_DATE("ui"."userBirth", 'YYYY-MM-DD')) / 12) AS "age",
'접속중' AS "status",
-- 거리 계산 (km 단위) TO_CHAR( SDO_GEOM.SDO_DISTANCE( "ul"."LOCATION", (SELECT "LOCATION" FROM "USER_LOCATIONS" WHERE "USERNO" = #{userNo}), 0.005, 'unit=KM' ), 'FM990.00' ) || ' km' AS "distance",
-- 이미지 리스트 (콤마로 구분된 문자열로 반환) (SELECT COALESCE(LISTAGG("img"."imageUrl", ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY "img"."imageUrl"), '') FROM "userImage" "img" WHERE "img"."userNo" = "u"."userNo") AS "images"
FROM "users" "u" JOIN "userInfo" "ui" ON "u"."userNo" = "ui"."userNo" JOIN "USER_LOCATIONS" "ul" ON "u"."userNo" = "ul"."USERNO" WHERE "u"."userNo" != #{userNo}
-- 내 성별과 다른 유저만 조회 AND "u"."userGender" != (SELECT "userGender" FROM "users" WHERE "userNo" = #{userNo})
-- 상태 및 권한 체크 (정상 유저만) AND "u"."userState" = '1000' AND "u"."userRole" = 'ROLE_USER'
-- 거리 필터링 (distanceKm 이내) AND SDO_GEOM.SDO_DISTANCE( "ul"."LOCATION", (SELECT "LOCATION" FROM "USER_LOCATIONS" WHERE "USERNO" = #{userNo}), 0.005, 'unit=KM' ) <= ${distanceKm}
-- 차단 유저 제외 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM "userBlock" "ub" WHERE "ub"."fromUserNo" = #{userNo} AND "ub"."toUserNo" = "u"."userNo" )
-- 내가 이미 스와이프(PANG/PASS)한 유저 제외 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM "swipe" "s" WHERE "s"."fromUserNo" = #{userNo} AND "s"."toUserNo" = "u"."userNo" AND "s"."swipeType" = 'PANG' )
-- 🛠️ [수정 2] 이미 매칭된 유저 제외 (matchState 컬럼 필요) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM "matchMapper" "mm" JOIN "matching" "m" ON "mm"."matchNo" = "m"."matchNo" WHERE "mm"."userNo" = #{userNo} AND "m"."matchState" = 'ACTIVE' AND "mm"."matchUserNo" = "u"."userNo" )
-- 가까운 거리 순 정렬 ORDER BY SDO_GEOM.SDO_DISTANCE( "ul"."LOCATION", (SELECT "LOCATION" FROM "USER_LOCATIONS" WHERE "USERNO" = #{userNo}), 0.005, 'unit=KM' ) ASC
